notes.max_discount: No unit may be offered or sold for less than list price x (1 - max_discount).
notes.min_margin: No unit may be offered or sold for less than cost / (1 - min_margin[category]); margin is (unit_price - cost) / unit_price.
notes.list_price: No unit may be offered or sold above its list price.
notes.stock: Never offer or sell more units of a product than its stock; stock 0 means out of stock.
notes.prices: Prices are final and in rupees: no fees, surcharges or taxes on top.
